protocol.data: Planetoid public splits; identical saved tensors per method/dataset
protocol.reduction_precision: float32; CGC reconstruction alone float64 on both implementations, ridge=0
protocol.cgc: spectral clustering; author FAISS vs package sklearn; both 10 restarts and at most 300 iterations; equal alpha/tau/augmentation/threshold
protocol.clustgdd: 600 pretraining + 100 refinement updates, hidden 256, 2 layers; equal propagation/dropout/sampling/loss settings
protocol.gcgp: 200 full-batch Adam updates, released SGNK/GP arithmetic, no learned adjacency; same initialization RNG device
protocol.quality: shared PyG 2-layer GCN, hidden256, 300 epochs, lr0.01, wd0.0005, dropout0; validation every10, test only at chosen checkpoint
protocol.timing: full in-memory reduction from common CPU tensors through normalized output contract; includes preprocessing and device transfers; excludes imports, input loading, serialization, downstream GCN and diagnostic GP test inference
protocol.memory: fresh process per job; sampled process RSS every5ms during reduction; CUDA peak allocated/reserved reset after context warmup; resident input/import baseline and increments retained
adapters: common data/split injection replaces each repository loader
CGC reconstruction precision harmonized to float64, both return float32
CGC FAISS and ClustGDD sklearn restart/iteration budgets explicitly matched to package clustering (10 x 300)
ClustGDD graph_compress receives integer cluster IDs (released caller supplies floats)
ClustGDD output uses unnormalized compressed adjacency for common GCN normalization
GCGP trains with the author train() definition; per-epoch test probes omitted from both sides
GCGP optimized target logits are softmaxed for shared downstream probability-regression loss
